structure: Part 1, journey glue and shared page chrome: 18 traces from four spec files, all opened and mined (the bundled trace CLI refuses these Playwright 1.63 zips with TraceVersionError, so each zip's extracted context trace, test trace and network log were read with jq in part1/; folder sizes were checked against the zip listing). journey-smoke.fit.spec.js (4 tests, project journeys): s1 = :31 entry guards and opening spine (9db27), s2 = :92 opening run to the review page (1ca52), s3 = :131 notification opened from another session (1beec), s4 = :153 change context from check answers (5e933). page-title.fit.spec.js (2): pt1 = :36 title pattern (2cd26), pt2 = :44 error prefix (b40e3). section-caption.fit.spec.js (5): sc1 = :52 consignment question (6b1ad), sc2 = :67 hidden-legend page (d7b0b), sc3 = :85 dashboard (a5814), sc4 = :96 overview bare (9e37a), sc5 = :104 axe with caption (b78a7). service-navigation.fit.spec.js (7): sn1 = :29 four items (da70d), sn2 = :35 dashboard current (e1a1f), sn3 = :43 current inside a notification (1a793), sn4 = :53 dashboard reachable from a notification (a40ce), sn5 = :72 sign-out href (e6c19), sn6 = :80 no signed-in user shown (1d6b5), sn7 = :91 axe on dashboard (b71ef). Pages walked, in order of the opening run (s2): stub sign-in, / redirect, dashboard /live-animals, POST /notifications creates the notification, origin, commodities (What are you importing?), consignment-details (Commodity details), import-reason, commodities/identification, additional-details, port-of-entry (Arrival details), transit-countries, transporters, accompanying-documents (Upload documents), addresses (Consignment addresses) with five party select pages, cph-number, consignment/contact/select, notification-view (Review your notification). Also walked: the overview (hub) at /notifications/<ref>, the origin page in its error state, the identification and documents pages in change mode (?change=1). Conditional: run mode (save chains to the next page) holds only until the user reaches the overview; additional details follows import reason; transit countries and transporters follow arrival details; cph-number follows addresses. Claims cover the journey glue (redirects, run mode, change context), the shared chrome on every page (title, header, service navigation, phase banner, footer, notification strip, caption, back link, button group), and each walked page's URL, title, caption and heading; each feature page's own fields, options and validation copy are left to that feature's part.
